_comment: Durable memory for the self-improving daily-AI-report loop. Written by meta.sh (the daily meta-agent) and read by run.sh (the report run). Delete this file to reset all learnings. Hand-edits are fine; the meta-agent merges, it does not clobber.

sources._comment: keyed by source name from sources.json. seen=runs where scanned, produced=runs where it contributed a kept item, failed=fetch errors, stale=returned data older than window, empty=scanned-but-nothing. status: active|degraded|disabled. The meta-agent flags degraded after a streak and may disable (never delete) with a reason.

AWS What's New (AI/ML).note: 2026-10-28: contributed again (SageMaker MLflow 3.16 trace explorer, score 3) via the dated RSS feed. Third in-window item on the RSS source across the reviewed runs; the undated-tavily problem stays resolved. Fully healthy.

Same pattern as 10-15 (Argon) — DeepMind's big launches surface on X before/instead of the blog listing. Not degraded (X path covers it), but noting the recurring blog-lag.

judgment._comment: calibration signals for the ranking/quiet-day logic

suspect_quiet_days.reason: Quiet day (0 items) declared, but the run explicitly did NOT fire Playwright for any of the 10 X.com timelines. Dated vendor/research sources were outside the 24h window, but the Tier-1/Tier-2 social tier was unverified, so the quiet verdict is unconfirmed. Guard added to PROMPT.md step 5 as a result; has held on every subsequent reviewed run (10-14, 10-15, 10-28 all scanned the full X tier).

notes: A 'quiet day' declared without scanning the playwright-x timelines is SUSPECT, not confirmed quiet. PROMPT.md step 5 carries an explicit guard forbidding a quiet declaration until all tiers incl. playwright-x are fetched. Guard has held on every reviewed run since 10-13 (10-14, 10-15, 10-28). Keep the guard.

SOURCE-COVERAGE GAP — research launched via arXiv+GitHub, not a first-party blog, can slip entirely. Harness² (Google Cloud AI Research, arXiv 2610.14224) was missed on 10-15 and only caught by a manual backfill (reports/2026-10-19.html): it never hit research.google/blog, the DeepMind blog, or @GoogleDeepMind, and the only catch-paths (HF Papers, GitHub Trending) are popularity-gated and lagged by days. Fix applied 10-28: added @GoogleResearch to the playwright-x list. Still-open idea (recorded, not yet implemented — would be a new source TYPE/behavior, bigger than a 2-change budget allows): an arXiv cs.AI 'agent/harness' watch with a 72h lookback for papers, since papers surface days after submission.

DeepMind's major launches surface on the @GoogleDeepMind X timeline before (or instead of) the blog listing — Argon GA (10-14/15) and Genie 4 (10-28) both arrived via X while the blog was quiet. Prefer the X timeline as the primary DeepMind signal; the blog lags.

Edge-of-window discipline is holding: on 10-28 the run correctly EXCLUDED Anthropic's S-1 (Oct 26) and OpenAI's frontier-training-security post (Oct 24) as just-outside-window, while keeping GPT-6.1 Terra on its Oct 27 announcement/promotion date (openai.com dated it Oct 26). Good calibration — don't let adjacent-day items double-count.

Undatable changelog pages (Cursor on 10-28; Claude Code CHANGELOG) are retained via the 'undated-but-top-entry' rule with an explicit note. Acceptable, but each such item is a small risk of importing a stale entry as 'today's' — keep flagging the approximate timing in the HTML.

reliability._comment: run-health history; one entry per report run appended by run.sh, graded by meta.sh. NOTE: no runs fired 10-16..10-18 or 10-20..10-27 (machine asleep/off; cron backfills only on wake). Absence of a run is not a failure — only graded days that actually fired appear here.

history.note: Manual backfill compiled 2026-10-21 (Harness² post-mortem), not a cron run; graded from the report file.

run.sh stdout log is sparse (only the started line + an unrecognized_model warning), but the report HTML is 13KB with 8 items from 34 sources and a complete footer — graded success from the report file.
